verses.text: Do you not know that you are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in you?
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
The Lord your God is in your midst, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will quiet you by his love; he will exult over you with loud singing.
But you, O Lord, are a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter of my head.
Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God; and so we are.
The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you.
No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
But God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He makes me lie down in green pastures.
And I am sure of this, that he who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ.
But you, O Lord, are a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
The Lord appeared to him from far away. I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you.
Where shall I go from your Spirit? Or where shall I flee from your presence?
Behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.
The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves.
I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me.
Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
Neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Pray without ceasing.
Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
The prayer of a righteous person has great power as it is working.
Pray at all times in the Spirit, with all prayer and supplication.
Call to me and I will answer you, and will tell you great and hidden things that you have not known.
And he told them a parable to the effect that they ought always to pray and not lose heart.
My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation.
Evening and morning and at noon I utter my complaint and moan, and he hears my voice.
O you who hear prayer, to you shall all flesh come.
Before they call I will answer; while they are yet speaking I will hear.
Seek the LORD and his strength; seek his presence continually!
Let my prayer be counted as incense before you, and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice!
With my voice I cry out to the LORD; with my voice I plead for mercy to the LORD.
Then you will call upon me and come and pray to me, and I will hear you.
In the days of his flesh, Jesus offered up prayers and supplications, with loud cries and tears, to him who was able to save him from death.
If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach, and it will be given him.
Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
And this is the confidence that we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will he hears us.
If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
You will seek me and find me, when you seek me with all your heart.
In my distress I called upon the LORD; to my God I cried for help.
Hear my cry, O God, listen to my prayer.
The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
When the righteous cry for help, the LORD hears and delivers them out of all their troubles.
Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your heart before him; God is a refuge for us.
So Peter was kept in prison, but earnest prayer for him was made to God by the church.
Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving.
Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage, and the ends of the earth your possession.
I sought the LORD, and he answered me and delivered me from all my fears.
Let your steadfast love, O Lord, be upon us, even as we hope in you.
He regards the prayer of the destitute and does not despise their prayer.
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
In the day of my trouble I call upon you, for you answer me.
Let my cry come before you, O LORD; give me understanding according to your word!
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God! Let your good Spirit lead me on level ground!
Hear the voice of my pleas for mercy, O LORD, when I cry to you for help.
Hear me, O LORD, and be gracious to me! O LORD, be my helper!
Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have given me relief when I was in distress.
O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob!
But truly God has listened; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in steadfast love to all who call upon you.
When he calls to me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him and honor him.
Let your ear be attentive to the cry of your servant.
Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD!
Hear my voice, O LORD; let your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for mercy!
Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
O LORD, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and watch.
Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before me.
But I, through the abundance of your steadfast love, will enter your house. I will bow down toward your holy temple in the fear of you.
Give ear to my prayer, O God, and hide not yourself from my plea for mercy!
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, O LORD, my rock and my redeemer.
But I call to God, and the LORD will save me.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep; for you alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
Seek the LORD while he may be found; call upon him while he is near.
O LORD of hosts, blessed is the one who trusts in you!
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
Hear my prayer, O LORD; give ear to my cries; hold not your peace at my tears!
Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord God is an everlasting rock.
I stretch out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land.
O Lord, hear my voice! Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for mercy!
When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
On the day I called, you answered me; my strength of soul you increased.
You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield.
Let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish the work of our hands upon us.
Make me to know your ways, O Lord; teach me your paths.
Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all the day long.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the LORD!
O Lord my God, I cried to you for help, and you have healed me.
When the cares of my heart are many, your consolations cheer my soul.
I sought the Lord, and he answered me and delivered me from all my fears.
Let my cry come before you, O Lord; give me understanding according to your word!
Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.
Keep steady my steps according to your promise, and let no iniquity get dominion over me.
My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
The Lord will keep you from all evil; he will keep your life.
He who calls you is faithful; he will surely do it.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another: just as I have loved you.
By this all people will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of sins.
Let love be genuine. Abhor what is evil; hold fast to what is good.
Love one another with brotherly affection. Outdo one another in showing honor.
If possible, so far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all.
Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you.
Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
So then, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to those who are of the household of faith.
Let all that you do be done in love.
And above all these put on love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.
Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which indeed you were called in one body. And be thankful.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom.
Encourage one another and build one another up.
Therefore welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God.
Be at peace among yourselves.
Let us pursue what makes for peace and for mutual upbuilding.
So then let us not pass judgment on one another any longer.
Not neglecting to meet together, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.
Having purified your souls by your obedience to the truth for a sincere brotherly love, love one another earnestly from a pure heart.
Let the brother who is lowly boast in his exaltation.
Show hospitality to one another without grumbling.
Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
Live in harmony with one another.
Let each of you look not only to his own interests, but also to the interests of others.
Do nothing from selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility count others more significant than yourselves.
Let your reasonableness be known to everyone.
We who are strong have an obligation to bear with the failings of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
For the whole law is fulfilled in one word: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep.
Let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths, but only such as is good for building up.
If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink.
Do not repay evil for evil, but give thought to do what is honorable in the sight of all.
Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
Put on then, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience.
Bearing with one another and, if one has a complaint against another, forgiving each other; as the Lord has forgiven you.
Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body.
We love because he first loved us.
Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
And this commandment we have from him: whoever loves God must also love his brother.
Little children, let us not love in word or talk but in deed and in truth.
The aim of our charge is love that issues from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.
Strive for peace with everyone, and for the holiness without which no one will see the Lord.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it.
Whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord, and he will repay him for his deed.
Whoever brings blessing will be enriched, and one who waters will himself be watered.
If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant or rude.
Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
So now faith, hope, and love abide, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
Let no one seek his own good, but the good of his neighbor.
Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse them.
Repay no one evil for evil, but give thought to do what is honorable in the sight of all.
He who loves his brother abides in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling.
If anyone says, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar.
By this we know love, that he laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
Owe no one anything, except to love each other, for the one who loves another has fulfilled the law.
You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
Let brotherly love continue.
Contribute to the needs of the saints and seek to show hospitality.
Beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God, and whoever loves has been born of God and knows God.
Whoever loves his brother abides in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling.
Let each of us please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
As for the one who is weak in faith, welcome him, but not to quarrel over opinions.
Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
Let us not love in word or talk but in deed and in truth.
Whoever isolates himself seeks his own desire; he breaks out against all sound judgment.
The one who loves another has fulfilled the law.
Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and clamor and slander be put away from you, along with all malice.
Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how you ought to answer each person.
Be devoted to one another in brotherly love.
For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
This is my command: Love each other.
All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
For in him the whole fullness of deity dwells bodily.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory.
He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his nature.
He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
He upholds the universe by the word of his power.
At the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth.
And every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Then he rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
Even the winds and the sea obey him.
And he touched her hand, and the fever left her.
Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of him, and the boy was healed instantly.
He said to the paralytic, Rise, pick up your bed, and go home.
He laid his hands on every one of them and healed them.
He cast out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick.
Jesus stood up and commanded the wind and the raging waves, and they ceased, and there was a calm.
He went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live.
I lay down my life that I may take it up again.
No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord.
I and the Father are one.
Whoever has seen me has seen the Father.
All things were made through him, and without him was not any thing made that was made.
In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
For in him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible.
He disarmed the rulers and authorities and put them to open shame, by triumphing over them in him.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger.
I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.
I am the door. If anyone enters by me, he will be saved.
I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser.
Before Abraham was, I am.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
He is the head of the body, the church. He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead.
For in him all the fullness of God was pleased to dwell.
He himself is our peace.
He has delivered us from the domain of darkness and transferred us to the kingdom of his beloved Son.
In him we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
He humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.
For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.
We have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
He is the propitiation for our sins.
Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
For the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
I am the good shepherd.
He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and of his kingdom there will be no end.
He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
For in him dwells all the fullness of Godhead bodily.
He is Lord of all.
He is King of kings and Lord of lords.
He has put all things under his feet.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
He must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
Death is swallowed up in victory.
He said to me, 'It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end.'
Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.
Behold, I am coming soon, bringing my recompense with me.
He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his faithfulness.
Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered.
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!
On his robe and on his thigh he has a name written, King of kings and Lord of lords.
He will reign forever and ever.
The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.
You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you.
The Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things.
When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth.
For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.
The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God.
The Spirit helps us in our weakness.
The Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
The Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you.
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness.
If we live by the Spirit, let us also keep in step with the Spirit.
The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.
Do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
You have been anointed by the Holy One.
And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses.
For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
Since we have the same spirit of faith, we also believe.
To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.
All these are empowered by one and the same Spirit.
Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you?
And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.
The Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words.
For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but of righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Guard the good deposit entrusted to you by the Holy Spirit who dwells within us.
You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses.
But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you.
For those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
To set the mind on the Spirit is life and peace.
If the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies.
But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
If we live by the Spirit, let us also walk by the Spirit.
Do not quench the Spirit.
For we were all baptized into one body in one Spirit.
To one is given through the Spirit the utterance of wisdom, and to another the utterance of knowledge.
For we are the temple of the living God.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
